about: Thomas P. Miller, an attorney with Keating, Bucklin & McCormack, Inc., P.S. in Seattle, Washington, helps clients address Civil Rights situations. He also helps clients with Civil Litigation: Defense and Personal Injury - General: Defense concerns.
He received legal training from University of Denver Sturm College of Law. He graduated from law school in 2003. Thomas Miller became licensed to practice law in 2003.
Thomas Miller was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that he is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. He was selected to Super Lawyers for 2020 - 2026.
